en-US.name: Meet Pimpi: Skinalyze 2.0
en-US.shortDescription: Your new skin-care buddy is here. Say hi!
en-US.longDescription: Skinalyze 2.0 is a whole new app. Pimpi cheers on your routine, guides your scans and earns outfits with you.

en-US.name: Your 2026 Skin Wrapped
en-US.shortDescription: Your skin-care year, in one swipeable recap.
en-US.longDescription: Your best streak, the products you stuck with and the habits that stayed. Here Jan 1–7 only.

en-US.name: 30 Days of Sunscreen
en-US.shortDescription: Start the year with SPF, one morning at a time.
en-US.longDescription: Tick off sunscreen each morning for 30 days. Pimpi keeps count, cheers you on and has a finisher card waiting.

en-US.name: 30 Days of Morning and Evening
en-US.shortDescription: Tick a step in the morning and one at night.
en-US.longDescription: One routine step in the morning and one in the evening, for 30 days. Pimpi counts every day you show up.

en-US.name: 30 Days of Hands Off
en-US.shortDescription: Keep your hands off your face for a month.
en-US.longDescription: Each evening, tap if you kept your hands off your face. Thirty days in, Pimpi has a finisher card for you.

en-US.name: Your Skin Wrapped: Jan–Mar
en-US.shortDescription: Your first three months of 2027, in one recap.
en-US.longDescription: Your best streak, your lessons and the routine you kept, from January to March. Here April 1–7 only.

en-US.name: Summer Sunscreen Challenge
en-US.shortDescription: Thirty June mornings of SPF. Ready?
en-US.longDescription: Tick sunscreen in your morning routine every day this June. Pimpi keeps count and cheers for each one.

en-US.name: Your Skin Wrapped: Apr–Jun
en-US.shortDescription: April to June, in one swipeable recap.
en-US.longDescription: Your best streak, your lessons and the routine you kept, from April to June. Here July 1–7 only.

en-US.name: Your Skin Wrapped: Jul–Sep
en-US.shortDescription: July to September, in one swipeable recap.
en-US.longDescription: Your best streak, your lessons and the routine you kept, from July to September. Here October 1–7 only.
